cases.name: transport failure after admission stays unknown (review section 13 case 6)
recorded ACK outranks a later non-settling error
recorded ACK outranks even a rejection kind

comment: Failed explicit reconciliation -> recorded outcome (observe.mjs failedReconcileOutcome; program section 15 norms 2/4, SDK SS4.13). Only a durable protocol rejection kind proves non-admission; any other failure settles nothing and the command stays unknown, never rejected. A recorded ACK outranks the error.
